title.narrative: Implementation Civil Protection Agencies cooperation - Implementation Swedish and Albanian Civil Protection Agencies cooperation

description.narrative: A long-term bilateral cooperation between Swedish and Albanian Civil Protection agencies in order to strengthen the role and performance of the Albanian Agency.
Ett långsiktigt bilateralt samarbete mellan svenska och albanska civilskyddsmyndigheter i syfte att stärka den albanska myndighetens roll och prestation.

The overall goal of the project is: Enhanced public awareness of disaster risks and household emergency preparedness in Albania. The overall goal constitutes the effects of the project on Albanian civil protection and disaster preparedness system, and will be fully revealed in a long term, beyond the project lifetime whereas, the effect of the project, attainable within the three years horizon is identified as its specific goal: Strengthened capacity of National Civil Protection Agency of Albania (NCPA) to guide and coordinate disaster preparedness efforts in Albania.
Achievement of the specific goal of the project is envisioned through the following outcomes, which form three main components of the project:
Component 1. Improved coherence and consistency of disaster preparedness efforts in Albania and its alignment with EU-s practices.
This component would focus on creating an umbrella for public awareness and crisis communication actions in Albania, establishing standards and elaborating tools for planning, development, implementation and evaluation of the effects of various public awareness initiatives in the country.
Component 2. Enhanced inter-institutional cooperation between academia/education sector and other civil protection actors in the area of public awareness and community preparedness. Effectiveness of disaster preparedness efforts is highly interlinked with coherence and consistency of the actions taken across the country. This could be reached through enhanced cooperation between various stakeholders active in this field, which is a core part of s mandate. Particular emphasis will be made on building the bridge between NCPA and academia/education sector (through Ministry of Education and Sports and other institutions), since this highlighted by the Law and National Disaster Risk Management Strategy. Component 3. Increased capacity of the central civil protection institutions and municipalities to communicate and to train their respective target audiences in civil protection and disaster preparedness. Following the logic described in the Theory of Change, after establishing the umbrella, providing direction and tools,public awareness & crisis communication efforts, the relevant stakeholders need to develop their capacity to apply to the tools and guidelines in practice. This implies a certain level of knowledge and understanding of the subject, skills to apply the provided tools, as well as trained ability to transfer knowledge to main recipients citizens.
